description.p: Hartmann Office is an office suite made for Luma. Write a document, work out a budget or put together a talk in one app that fits on a computer, a tablet, a phone and a TV.

ul.li: Documents: titles, headings, lists, quotes, bold, italic, underline and alignment, with a live word count and find and replace
Spreadsheets: formulas with more than 50 functions, several sheets, number formats, sorting, fill down and copy and paste between cells
Presentations: title, points and section slides in five themes, speaker notes, and a full screen Present mode
Open and save OpenDocument files (.odt, .ods, .odp) that other office apps read, plus CSV and Markdown
Export any file as a PDF, or print it
Everything saves as you go, and deleted files wait 30 days in Deleted before they are gone

description.p: Hartmann Office is free, with no ads. Office Pro is an optional purchase (a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time unlock, paid through Stripe) that adds templates, premium slide themes, version history, and headers, footers and page numbers. Everything above stays free.
Hartmann Office works offline, has no account and collects nothing. Your files stay on your device unless you choose to save a copy somewhere else.
